query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM npc_agent WHERE npc_agent.character_id = speech.speaker_character_id) AS "npc!: bool" FROM npc_response_source JOIN message ON message.id = npc_response_source.message_id JOIN speech ON speech.action_id = message.action_id WHERE npc_response_source.collection_id = ? ORDER BY npc_response_source.message_id DESC LIMIT 1
